Why this is promising: path intrusion directly captures forward-corridor relevance, whereas expansion can also occur for visually growing objects outside the intended path. Giving intrusion slightly more influence should improve discrimination and ranking without weakening the two principal approach cues. The negative reliability correction remains bounded by corroborated motion, and the formula remains deterministic and within `[0, 1]` for normalized inputs.
